title: restore_state() bypasses _sequence_started rewind guard and can reuse a tuple
description: link_layer.py:2093-2095 -> 2024-2027: set_sequence() refuses to rewind after first use (_sequence_started guard, RuntimeError at 1927-1928), but _restore_security_state overwrites _epoch/_seqnum unconditionally, taking neither _tx_lock nor the guard. A mid-operation restore rewinds the counter so two legitimately signed frames share one (epoch, seqnum) with different payloads; peer replay windows accept at most one sighting and drop the other (availability loss, no forgery). Fix: apply the same _sequence_started refusal (and take _tx_lock) on the restore path, matching set_sequence(). Found by security codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-9qpz.
